newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker listless on pre-weekend mood.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker listless on pre-weekend mood.

text.p: The Singapore bunker market was listless on Friday with few players taking part before the weekend holiday, traders said.
"The market will improve if the fuel oil market drops. Bunker levels now are just too low compared with cargo prices," said one trader. Fuel oil 380-cst was quoted at about $94/$95.
Majors said they were quoting the 380-cst grade at around $97/$98 per tonne while some independents offered what majors said "unreasonable" prices at $2-$3 per tonne lower.
MDO and gas oil were quoted around $190 and $200 respectively.
